fields.message:
"Engelhard Sunrise"

Dawn breaks over the marina at Engelhard, painting the sky in layers of orange and pink.

The fishing boats rest quietly at their moorings, their masts rising like dark brushstrokes against the glowing horizon. Not a ripple disturbs the water — the harbor holds the sky's reflection so perfectly that the world seems to double itself in the stillness. It's that rare, unhurried moment before the day begins, when the coast belongs only to the light.

Ray had a way of finding these silent hours and letting them speak for themselves.
